//: Firebase RTDB security rules untuk project VinzryyySaga (Armeniaca / Eli).
//1: Cara apply: Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules tab → paste isi file ini → Publish.
//2: Atau via CLI: `firebase deploy --only database` (butuh firebase-tools + login).
//3: Default-deny di root — semua path yang gak di-declare di-tolak write & read.

memory_lb.//: Pasangkan Momen daily leaderboard. Only /api/memory-leaderboard reads/writes it (service account, bypasses rules) after replaying the game.

fan_stories.//: Approved Cerita Penggemar. Public read; written only by /api/fan-stories after an admin approves.

fan_stories_pending.//: Submitted stories waiting for review. Never public; only /api/fan-stories touches it.

eli_schedule.//: Eli schedule entries from /admin/jadwal. Public read (the site reads via REST). No client writes: /api/admin-schedule checks the daily password and writes as the service account, which bypasses these rules.
